findings.summary: The dd-acceptance gate (.dev-dispatch/spec/approved.md dd-acceptance block) and run-config acceptance_commands (.dev-dispatch/run-config.json) both require `npm test` (unscoped), but the implement verification record (.dev-dispatch/handoffs/1f139fd7-a039-5969-a9bd-98971a3dc018/implement.json) substituted `npm test -- test/c1-preflight.test.ts` (scoped, 14 passed). The unscoped `npm test` is not demonstrated to pass; the prior final review (.dev-dispatch/reviews/rf-e156b85b.../review.json) established it exits 1 with {failed:2, passed:791, total:793}. This attempt's deploy/README.md sec 8 identifies the 2 failing tests (test/a10b-convergence.test.ts B1 'empty terminal board drains' and B2 'leaves research.evidence.v2') and argues they are pre-existing on the frozen base c76594d5 due to an external loop-engine build/model-registry version mismatch, providing a git-diff argument that the C1 commit does not touch the failing test files or their dependency chain. This addresses the prior final review's identification concern. However, the acceptance gate itself was not run as specified: the implement actor scoped the test command at verification time without amending the spec or run-config. All seven C1 product deliverables are otherwise correct: versioned schema (deploy/contract/application-declaration.v1.schema.json covers identity, artifact ref+commit, command, working_directory, required_environment, health.command, rollback ref+commit); two declarations (deep-research runnable, chatgroup-daemon declaration-only with placeholder 00..0 commit); deterministic fail-closed preflight (src/preflight.ts:202 runPreflight is read-only using only fs.readFileSync/existsSync/accessSync(X_OK), no deploy branch in src/preflight-entry.ts, each check has a stable error_code and nonzero exit before any deploy action); preflight-only mode emitting resolved immutable commit and sha256 declaration digest; raw green/red stdout+stderr fixtures (test/fixtures/preflight/green-deep-research.stdout.txt shows status=PASS application=deep-research commit=c76594d5... digest=sha256:a1d647fb...; red-missing-env.stdout.txt shows status=FAIL error_code=REQUIRED_ENV_MISSING with no phase:deploy/effects marker); deployment alignment proof (deploy/README.md sec 5: declaration commit equals checked artifact commit, deployment only from merged remote main via git pull --ff-only, production checkout never a dev/verification location). The test (test/c1-preflight.test.ts) drives the real CLI entrypoint via execFileSync(vite-node src/preflight-entry.ts) and does not mock the runner. The blocker is solely that the dd-acceptance gate was not verified as specified.
